content:
The fastest animal depends on the environment:

**Air**: The **peregrine falcon** is the fastest, reaching speeds over 240 mph (386 km/h) when diving to catch prey.

**Land**: The **cheetah** holds the record at up to 70 mph (112 km/h) in short bursts.

**Water**: The **black marlin** is considered the fastest fish, reaching speeds around 80 mph (129 km/h).

So overall, the peregrine falcon is the fastest animal on Earth when you consider all environments.
